messages:
sam: heads up — we just got an escalated ticket from ACME. Multiple 504s on /v1/generate between 15:02-15:10 UTC. Customer reports long tail latency then gateway timeouts.

tia: saw the alert, jumping in. Any deploys or config changes?

sam: no deploys. infra metrics show a burst in request queueing. KEDA scaled from 0 -> 1 but readiness never passed for ~90s. HPA didn't kick because minReplicas=0 and external metrics lagged.

ben: can you paste pod events + scaledobject?

sam: pasting key bits below. truncated for brevity.

```kubectl describe pod model-server-xyz
Name:           model-server-xyz
Namespace:      prod
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age   From     Message
  ----     ------     ----  ----     -------
  Warning  Unhealthy  85s   kubelet  Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 502
  Normal   Pulling    70s   kubelet  Pulling image "registry/redwood/model:stable"
  Normal   Started    52s   kubelet  Started container
```

and scaledobject snippet:
```yaml
apiVersion: keda.sh/v1alpha1
kind: ScaledObject
metadata:
  name: model-server-scaledobj
spec:
  scaleTargetRef:
    name: model-deployment
  pollingInterval: 30
  cooldownPeriod: 300
  minReplicaCount: 0
  triggers:
  - type: prometheus
    metadata:
      serverAddress: http://prom
```

marta: cooldownPeriod=300 + minReplicaCount=0 explains slow reaction. Also readiness failing — looks like model init is hitting IO/CPU ceiling while trying to warm cache.

sam: model-init logs show repeated timeouts while fetching shards: "cache warmup: downloading shard 3/8" then "timeout after 60s".

infra-eng: I see that the pods are node-scheduled onto machines with high disk IO at the time. Could be contention from backups.

opsbot: Incident labeled P1 and routed to oncall. Dashboard link: https://dashboard.redwood/incidents/3182467890 :rotating_light:

tia: repro steps from support (copied):
1) send steady stream of small requests to /v1/embeddings until traffic drops to 0
2) wait 2 minutes
3) fire 20 concurrent /v1/generate requests
Expected: KEDA/HPA spin up and respond <10s
Observed: 504s and queued requests >60s

ben: quick mitigation options: set minReplicaCount=1 on ScaledObject or bump deployment replicas; reduce cooldownPeriod to 60s; increase readinessProbe initialDelaySeconds to 120 to avoid false failures during model init.

sam: trying quick patch now: `kubectl patch scaledobject model-server-scaledobj -n prod --type merge -p '{"spec": {"minReplicaCount": 1, "cooldownPeriod": 60}}'`

support-lead: communicating to ACME: "We’ve applied configuration to ensure at least one warm replica and are monitoring. ETA 30m for verification. Will follow up with postmortem and mitigation plan."

sam: patch applied. Observability — queue depth dropping, first pod reported ready at +28s after patch. Loading times improved, no further 504s seen in the sample traffic. :thumbsup:

marta: long-term fixes:
- introduce prefix cache pre-warm on scale-up for large models
- minimize model init IO by staging weights on local SSDs or using async fetch with progressive readiness
- revisit default scaledobject cooldown/polling for prod workloads (pollingInterval 10, cooldownPeriod 60, minReplicaCount 1 for customer-tiered models)
- add a pre-warmed standby pool for top tenants

ben: logging action items: 1) temporary config change tracked in infra ticket #INF-423, 2) postmortem + PO to propose scaling defaults, 3) alert rule tweak to include readyness failure spikes.

support-lead: ACME updated and ticket moved to pending verification. Thanks everyone.

infra-eng: will follow up with a node/IO investigation — provisioning team alerted.

sam: closing thread for now, will file formal postmortem once we have root cause. :white_check_mark:
